unit: Semantic cases grouped by original photograph; both ZH and EN must complete with acceptable quality. Translations are not independent cases.

stage1.decisions: Ten unsupported requests must decline with unsupported_tools and no result; ten explicit no-ops must keep the exact input pixels. Both languages required. Controls are on ten already reused developer photos, not an independent dataset.

assessment: Codex direct executed-image AI review with model identity hidden during grading; all uncertainty and same-pixel conflicts preserved. Frozen raw7B visual screening previously failed directional calibration and is reference-only, not an independent reliable judge.
refusal_policy: On feasible native/controlled tasks, every decline remains uncompleted and is separately reported as a refusal. No result image or input fallback is allowed for decline. Fewer outputs cannot inflate completion counts.
comparisons: Parent fixed R10 language-merger final parameters re-executed on R11 editor, CPU-only replay; no new inference.
One R11 correction from the same exact116 parent tensors, same input prompt and strict parser, new editor.
Frozen R10 parent on R7 editor and original practical default retained as controls.

selection.checkpoint: Final epoch1 step336 fixed before training; no loss-based selection.
selection.eligibility: Native>=16/20 and old>=4/6 and decision controls20/20, with0 marked major; then controlled>=81/100 with0 major. Feasible-task refusal is uncompleted. Must improve editing without new severe destruction.
rank: Single predefined route, no post-hoc checkpoint choice

acceptance.open_after: Select route/checkpoint on development, lock actual adapter/parser/prompt/editor, then seed replicate selected route only if developmental gates pass. Final acceptance outcomes never choose checkpoint or parameters.
acceptance.qualitative_gate: Native>=16/20 bilingual complete acceptable, zero major; controlled>=81/100 complete acceptable, zero major; report every task/domain/failure and compare current under identical inputs. Passing is AI evidence, not proof of high practical usefulness or user approval.

preservation: Existing native20 and controlled100 acceptance files unchanged and remain sealed for inference. Never choose a checkpoint or modify parameters after acceptance.

resource.includes: All occupied model load, label proposals/screening, training, evaluation, replication and trial time

limitations: Development images repeatedly viewed historically; not pristine independent evaluation.
Direct AI review, not human or user approval. Unresolved historical uncertainty is retained.
New synthetic conditions use old training photos; no new independent original group.
